findings.note: ESPN's game page lists Sabres goalie Alex Lyon, C Sam Carrick and D Matt Grzelcyk and Conor Timmins on IR. It shows Luukkonen at a .863 save percentage, a 3.60 Sabres goals-against average and Columbus up 1-0 in the season series after a 6-3 win. Its listed records conflict with other sources.

Columbus played Thursday, beating Dallas in a shootout with Talbot in goal, so tonight is a back-to-back and Greaves may start. The Jackets also recalled forwards Lorentz and Williams, and their preview notes the 6-3 opening-night win over Buffalo.
Covers lists trends of the Sabres going 5-1 in their last 6 games as a favorite and the home team going 6-1 in the last 7 meetings. It shows no expert or computer picks for this game.

ESPN's goalie comparison has every listed goalie saving below .890 (Greaves .883, Talbot .867, Luukkonen .863, Ellis .864) with GAAs from 3.19 to 3.54. The page lists no confirmed starters, and its team records don't match the ones Covers shows.

Covers had no expert, computer or consensus picks yet. Its trends point both ways: Over is 4-0 in Buffalo's last 4 and 8-1 in its last 9 against the East, but Under is 4-0 in Columbus's last 4 as an underdog.

Columbus played Dallas on Thursday, so this game is the second night of a back-to-back. Talbot and Greaves were expected to split the two starts, and tonight's goalie wasn't confirmed. Covers lists the line at o6.5.
